 JUST RELEASED: Advent International on Private Equity Deals 
 
 JUST RELEASED: Advent International on Private Equity Deals Dec 7, 2022

 The seventh episode of Season One
of Private Equity Deals released this morning. I'm joined by Tricia
Glynn, Managing Director at Advent International. We discuss their
purchase of Orveon, a carve out of Shiseido comprised of three
beauty brands. The transaction highlights the many moving parts of
carveouts, a transaction Advent has completed 80 times over the
years. Tune in to Private Equity Deals to hear the
story.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
